interactions.text: South road: the Greymere Outskirts, and the training grounds beyond.
The north arch. Past it, the ridge path climbs to the old ruins. Nobody goes up there, which is mostly why Joey does.
The spring water tastes of iron this week. Everyone has noticed. Nobody has said so to Silas.
Dried herbs hang above clean bottles. Everything is within easy reach.
The timber smells of smoke and spilled ale. Someone has set out fresh mugs.
Old maps lie beneath fresh notes. Several passages have been carefully covered.
Gell's ledger lies open beside a stack of Civara broadsheets he insists are recent.
Lamp oil, salt, needles and thread, each priced in Gell's careful hand.
Wares from passing merchants. Gell can say where each one was made, accurately or not.
A crate of lamp oil, labelled INN in Gell's careful hand. It is heavier than Gell said.
A deck of cards, a half-finished wager slip and three mugs nobody has washed.
The lid won't quite close over the things Joey swears he found.
The fire is banked low. Joey's ma keeps a pot on it whatever the hour.
Work gloves, a spare shirt and the rope from yesterday's job.
Bread, a knife and a note in Lena's hand: EAT SOMETHING.
Tools for tomorrow's work, laid out the way you like them.
You lie down for a moment. It helps more than you expected.
Your bed. Made this morning, mostly.

route_01.name: Greymere Outskirts — Route 01
route_01.subtitle: The road beyond home

npcs.name: Apprentice Rowan
npcs.intro: Heading into Greymere? Let's see if you've got what it takes!
npcs.after: That was a good lesson. Keep an eye on the grass off the road.

npcs.name: Travelling Squire
npcs.intro: A good duelist should always be prepared. Show me your technique!
npcs.after: Well fought. Supplies from Gell will help on a longer journey.

npcs.name: Wandering Challenger
npcs.intro: I've been waiting for someone worth challenging!
npcs.after: A fine match. The road beyond the north gate is closed for now.

npcs.name: Old Greymaw
npcs.intro: A low growl rolls out of the hollow. Old Greymaw rises — bigger than the stories, its eyes catching a strange gold light.

npcs.name: Roadside Traveller
npcs.text: The main road is safe to follow. Training parties gather in the tall grass. There are supplies along the western clearing.

interactions.text: Greymere Outskirts — Travellers beware. Duelists often train along these roads.
North road closed. The next region will open in a future chapter.
Paw prints the size of a dinner plate, pressed deep into the mud. They head south, off the road.
Claw marks score the bank. Something heavy has been using this gap in the hedge.
A traveller's camp, torn apart. The bedroll is shredded and the food sack is gone. A Hi-Potion survived, wedged under the chest.
Old Greymaw's hollow. Grey fur snagged on every root, and the ground still warm. The ridge hums faintly underfoot.
Marshwort, growing thick in the reeds at the pond's edge. You cut what Lena asked for and a little more.

route_01.encounter_message: A roadside raider emerges from the tall grass. Prepare your party!

npcs.name: Riven Wisp
npcs.intro: The light knots itself into something that turns toward you.
npcs.after: Only cold air where it was.

npcs.name: Riven Wisps
npcs.intro: The light knots itself into something that turns toward you.
npcs.after: Only cold air where it was.

interactions.text: An old basin of still water. The air around it is calm, and so, for a moment, are you.
A tin lantern on its side, still warm. There's a J scratched into the lid. Joey's.
Bronze fittings, prised out of the wall years ago. Somebody has been coming down here a long time.
A survey pack, dropped in a hurry. Avelan stamps on the straps.

court_gallery.name: THE DROWNED GALLERY
court_gallery.subtitle: Still water, older than the town

npcs.name: Riven Husk
npcs.intro: The light knots itself into something that turns toward you.
npcs.after: Only cold air where it was.

interactions.text: Rings scorched into the floor, one inside another. People knelt here and tried to answer something. A long time ago.
Names cut into the stone, centuries old. Most have been struck through.
A brass survey peg with Avelan markings, snapped in half. Hale's team got this far.
A disc of gold set into the floor, lines running out from it to every wall. It is warm. It is humming.
CLASSIFICATION HALL. Registrants report to the clerk. Resonance testing in order of arrival. No Crest demonstrations in the forecourt.
A bench for registrants. You sit. Nobody tells you to stand.
Six resonance patterns, six columns in a ledger. In every row but one, a single column is ticked.
